newsitem.title: UK: Major says inflation threat seems dead in UK.
newsitem.headline: Major says inflation threat seems dead in UK.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said on Sunday that the threat of inflation appeared dead in Britain.

Major told BBC television's "Breakfast With Frost" show that "it looks as if we've killed inflation as a serious threat" and urged voters not to risk renewed economic problems by electing a Labour government in the May 1 election.

"The sick man of Europe in 1979 is now the role model of Europe economically in 1997," said Major, who is widely tipped to lose next month's race. Yet only with the ruling Conservatives, he said, could the economic success story last.
